title: ATLAS model card — regulatory-ready conformance profile
description: Cumulative on procurement-ready: adds predetermined change control (FDA/MHRA PCCP or EU AI Act Annex IV point 2(f) technical solutions for continuous compliance), a declared bias-mitigation approach, and cybersecurity measures (security posture) as currently-expressible increments toward the HTI-1 / EU AI Act Annex IV convergent gap set.
$comment: Cumulative: allOf-references procurement-ready.json so every procurement-ready constraint still applies (including its own promotion of Datasets and per-record Test type to required), then adds its own increment (each nested `required` is restated down to the leaf per the note's "required does not cascade" trap; this branch defines no new properties). Bias-mitigation approach and security posture were DEFERRED at this profile's creation and have since been added to the base schema (ROADMAP:04126 Bias mitigation approach, ROADMAP:04115 Cybersecurity measures); promoted to required below. A Maintenance object has also since been added to the base schema and is promoted to required below. Structured training-data characterization and at least one performance record with Test type "External" were also DEFERRED and are now expressible via the base schema's Datasets/Role and Model-performance/Test type fields (added for procurement-ready); this profile adds `contains` constraints requiring at least one Datasets entry with Role "Training" and at least one performance record with Test type "External". A card-level Factors declaration, a Subgroup on individual performance results, a Foundation model declaration, and Third-party components have also since been added to the base schema (Model.Factors, Model-performance-results.items.oneOf[].properties.Subgroup, Model-properties.Foundation model, Model-properties.Third-party components), but are deliberately NOT promoted to required here: none of subgroup disaggregation, foundation-model use, or third-party components is applicable to every model, so this profile leaves them optional rather than forcing a declaration that may not apply. Still DEFERRED pending fields that do not yet exist in the base schema (per the note's "profiles cannot ship first" and the HTI-1/Annex IV convergent-gap list): human-oversight measures. This will be added to this profile once a corresponding base-schema field exists.
